name: Basalt Columns
objection: Resolved review to keep: Wikivoyage and Tourism Chatham Islands (calls it one of the most popular attractions) both name it. A gate key from Hotel Chathams is a bookable arrangement a source explains, not a closed site. Coordinates -43.807,-176.64908 from Wikivoyage See listing.
photo_reason: CC BY-SA 2.0 (Kristina D.C. Hoeppner, Flickr), 2023-03-02, category Basalt Columns, Chatham Island. Hexagonal columns at the shore clearly shown, colour, 5985 px; hero crop shows the columns well. Not in imageOverrides.

name: Hapupu National Historic Reserve
objection: Resolved review to keep: DOC, Wikivoyage and the tourism board all name it, a national historic reserve and the last concentration of Moriori tree carvings. Wikivoyage states how: only with concessionaire guides from Hotel Chathams or Awarakau Farmstays, so a visitor can book it. (DOC page slug I tried 404s; Wikivoyage and tourism page read.) Coordinates fine (existing -43.80202,-176.35277; Wikivoyage -43.799,-176.35333).
photo_reason: Existing spot, not a new keep. Commons has only a close-up tree-trunk carving (File:Chatham Island Tree Carving.JPG, 1536 px, CC BY-SA 3.0): a close-up of one carving, fails check 3 for a hero. No better file found; confirm its current app photo separately.

name: Nunuku's Cave
objection: For: Wikivoyage See entry (-43.86055,-176.5242) says the cave has authentic ancient rock carvings and the Nunuku story. Against: one counted source, tourism board does not list it, no access or visit information, so cannot confirm a visitor can enter. Stays review.

name: Pitt Island
objection: Confirmed: Wikivoyage ('no trip would be complete') and tourism board ('often the highlight') name it; day trip by Air Chathams with a guide. Existing spot, no photo work requested.

name: Point Munning Seal Colony
objection: Confirmed: Wikivoyage (-43.72751,-176.20684, park at the fence, short bush walk to the beach) and Tourism Chatham Islands ('Seal Colony at Point Munning', a 47 ha covenant) name it; a real wildlife visit of about an hour.
photo_reason: Only Commons photo (File:Seal colony at Point Munning (52784888826).jpg, 4608 px, CC BY-SA 2.0) is a rocky shore where the seals are tiny specks; in the hero crop no seals are recognisable, fails check 3. Openverse has no other Point Munning photo (same Flickr file). Needs a tourism board or DOC photo (tier 2, permission) or the owner's own.

name: Te Whanga Lagoon
objection: Confirmed: Wikivoyage and DOC name it. Existing spot, no photo work requested.

name: Admiral Gardens
objection: Confirmed: Wikivoyage (-43.804,-176.6164, 23 km from Waitangi, bookable via Hotel Chathams) and the tourism board ('a beautiful garden made for birds, bees and butterflies') name it; garden plus reserve and dune walk is an hour or more. The Long Beach walk is part of it.
photo_reason: Commons has only close-ups of benches, a chair and dahlias from 2023 (Kristina D.C. Hoeppner, CC BY-SA 2.0): none shows the garden as a place, fail check 3. Needs a tourism board photo (tier 2) or another source.

name: Long Beach
objection: Changed to reject: part of the Admiral Gardens spot (Wikivoyage names it only as the end of that walk through the dunes), one counted source, so not a distinct draw.

name: Awatotara Bush Coastal Walk
objection: Confirmed: Wikivoyage (Tuku Tours, 2.5-3 h walk, independent $15 or guided) and the tourism board list it as its own attraction. Coordinates: Wikivoyage Tuku Tours point -44.007,-176.609 (the farm start, not a trailhead survey).
photo_reason: Only Commons hit (File:20180930 Chathams 153.jpg) is a close-up of a Chatham pigeon on grass, not the walk: fails checks 2 and 3. No walk photo on Commons or Openverse.

name: Tuku Nature Reserve
objection: Changed to reject: the only source (Wikivoyage) names the Tuku Valley through Tuku Tours, whose walk is the Awatotara Bush Coastal Walk already kept: a near-duplicate of that spot.

name: Tommy Solomon Statue
objection: For: Wikivoyage (-44.03327,-176.33631) and tourism board ('a must-visit for all travellers') both name it; stop pairs with Manakau, the descendants' property. Against: a 1985 statue, a minor memorial and short roadside stop on the same terms as the Bridge of Remembrance; the Wikipedia views (29k) are for the person, not the statue. Owner call.

name: Kōpinga Marae
objection: Confirmed: Wikivoyage ('Tours on Wednesdays at 10:00 am', phone +64 3 305 0450, Owenga Road, opened 2005, contemporary Moriori carvings) and tourism board name it; guided tour confirmed by Wikivoyage, worth about an hour. Keep, flag tour-only timing: hours should read 'Guided tour Wednesdays 10:00 AM, by arrangement'.
photo_reason: Current app photo (archive B&W of people) fails. Commons offers only File:Cindy Kiro and Richard Davies at Kopinga Marae.jpg (group of people on the steps, 2024; the people are the subject, fails check 3) and an Openverse Flickr group photo of schoolchildren in front of the marae porch (dwc.internal, CC BY-SA, 768x1024, below 960 wide landscape need and people as subject). No clean marae photo found: needs a Hokotehi Moriori Trust or tourism board photo (tier 2, permission).

name: German Mission House
objection: Confirmed: Wikivoyage (Waitangi West Road, 1866-68, caretaker Helen gives a tour for an entry fee, -43.7645,-176.77822) and the tourism board ('Open by appointment only, but an absolute must see', Maunganui Stone Cottage). Keep with hours 'By appointment'. Note the tourism page's name is Maunganui Stone Cottage; wiki alt name Stone Cottage.
photo_reason: CC BY-SA 2.0 (Kristina D.C. Hoeppner), 2023-03-02, category German Mission House, so right place; shows the cottage in its dune and grass setting, colour, 6020 px. At default centre the cottage is clipped at the left edge; hero_crop x 0.4 puts it in frame (checked). Not in imageOverrides.

name: Sunderland NZ4111 Flying Boat
objection: For: Wikivoyage (-43.73649,-176.24567) and the tourism board ('a surprising encounter', relatively intact 1945 fuselage) both name it. Against: kept in a shed on the private Muirson/Murchison farm at Kaiwhata, access only through the farm contact (021 731 634), under restoration, and a ten-minute look. Owner call.

name: Mission Bay Ruins
objection: Merged with Te Whakaru (same site on the Murchison/Muirson farm: Wikivoyage 'Mission Bay', -43.73965,-176.21376; tourism board 'Te Whakaru': old cemetery, German mission remnants and shipwreck sites), so it now has two counted sources, but those are one farm visit arranged by phone with the same contact as Point Munning and the flying boat. For: two sources, history. Against: ruins and a cemetery only, arranged visit, little to do. Keep as one review entry under this name; Te Whakaru stays rejected as the duplicate.

name: Te Whakaru
objection: Agree with reject as a near-duplicate, but note it is the tourism board's name for the Mission Bay Ruins site; its source counts towards that review entry.

name: Port Hutt
objection: Confirmed: Wikivoyage ('one of the most attractive ports in New Zealand', -43.8148,-176.7087) and the tourism board (sheltered cove in Whangaroa Harbour) name it; also the site of the 1874 Transit of Venus station with interpretation shelter. Second-tier harbour town/bay a real source names, keep.
photo_reason: CC BY-SA 4.0, 2019-12-29, category Port Hutt, coordinates -43.807,-176.706 match Port Hutt. A clear view of the bay and beach in colour, 6155 px wide but 2.9:1 so the default hero is mid-water; hero_crop x 0.35 centres on the bay (checked, bay and beach visible). All other Port Hutt Commons files are interpretive signs. Not in imageOverrides.

name: Kaingaroa
objection: Confirmed: Wikivoyage (fishing village, -43.733,-176.2683) and the tourism board (picturesque bay, sandy beaches, endemic plants and birds) name it. The Saturday seafood night at the club is an event and does not count; the village and bay do. Keep.
photo_reason: Public domain (own work), 2009-10-21, category Kaingaroa Harbour, Chatham Islands, so right place. Beach, wharf and bay in colour, 2048 px; hero crop shows the wharf and beach clearly. Date 2009 is after 2000. Not in imageOverrides.

name: Ocean Mail Scenic Reserve
objection: Confirmed: DOC page (Manauea/Ocean Mail Scenic Reserve, 831 ha peat dome and wetland, 4 km of dunes on the Kaingaroa road), Wikivoyage (walks of 15 min, 20 min and 2.5 h; beach picnic area) and tourism board. Several walks, enough for a visit; keep. Coordinates Wikivoyage -43.7529,-176.3846. DOC's page slug is manauea-ocean-mail-scenic-reserve; consider the name 'Manauea/Ocean Mail Scenic Reserve'.
photo_reason: No Commons photo of the reserve (only plant close-ups). The DOC page image (Jess MacKenzie, 'DOC') is a tier-2 official photo needing permission; not downloaded.

name: Nikau Bush Conservation Area
objection: Confirmed: DOC page (19 ha of nikau forest, largest stand, access by a 1 km walk uphill from the North Road) and Wikivoyage (two loop walks, about an hour). Keep. Coordinates: Wikipedia -43.76417,-176.56611 (Wikivoyage -43.7636,-176.5696).
photo_reason: Commons Category Nikau Bush Conservation Area (2026, CC BY-SA 4.0) has only close-ups of leaves, flowers, signs and one nikau palm trunk looking up (Nīkau Bush - MC 01.jpg), none an establishing view of the forest: fail check 3. DOC page image (J Mackenzie, DOC) is tier 2.

name: Tikitiki Hill
objection: Changed to reject: both sources (DOC and Wikivoyage) give a 10-minute return walk, short of the half-hour bar, and it is a lookout over Waitangi already covered by the Waitangi town stop (mention it in Waitangi's bio).

name: Caravan Bush
objection: Changed to reject: one source; two short walks inside a fence on Pitt Island, restricted to guided tours from Flowerpot Lodge, so part of the Pitt Island day visit rather than a distinct draw.

name: Mount Hakepa
objection: For: tourism board 'bucket list' stand at the first place in the world to greet the new day (North Head, Pitt Island). Against: one counted source, no article, not on Wikivoyage, on a farm with homestay access. Coordinates (no OSM/Nominatim: both returned 429 for me): the only sourced point is Wikivoyage 'Hakepa Homestays, North Head Farm' -44.2702,-176.1656, which is the farm, not the summit; verify before placing.

name: Chatham Islands Museum
objection: Confirmed: Wikivoyage ('one of the best kept secrets of the Chathams', -43.95208,-176.56098, Tuku Rd) and the tourism board. A one-room museum in Waitangi, open to the public; about an hour. Marginal on size but two counted sources and the only museum, keep; opening hours are not stated by either source (call 022 081 8826), so hours need confirming.
photo_reason: No museum photo on Commons or Openverse (Commons search returns historical engravings and a Wellington museum rock; Openverse a school photo). Needs a tourism board photo (tier 2).

name: Waitangi
objection: Confirmed: Wikivoyage and tourism board name the town as the main port; the only settlement. Existing spot, no photo work requested.

name: Henga Scenic Reserve
objection: Confirmed: DOC page (170 ha, dune system, coastal forest, limestone outcrops, views over Petre Bay; roadside pull-off and sign on North Road) and tourism board (walk through regenerating kopi to a lookout). Wikivoyage's Henga Lodge entry gives a 2 h return walk to the beach. Keep. Coordinates: no point on the DOC page; Nominatim and Overpass returned 429. Best sourced proxy is Wikivoyage Henga Lodge, adjacent to the reserve, -43.84733,-176.54788 (North Rd 1297); mark as approximate and re-check with OSM.
photo_reason: No Commons photo found (Commons 'Henga' returns Bethells Beach in Auckland, the wrong place). File:Long Beach, Petre Bay looking north.jpg shows Petre Bay dunes but 1536x~250 extreme panorama and not proven to be Henga: fail. DOC page image (Jess MacKenzie, DOC; henga-reserve-sign-1920.jpg is a sign): tier 2.

name: Splatter Rock
objection: For: tourism board names Wharekauri Station and 'Taniwha / Splatter Rock' with a Maori legend. Against: one counted source, a private working station visited by arrangement (027 618 5718), exact location not given, no second source. Stays review.

name: Contemplation Bay
objection: For: tourism board describes a 300 m limestone bay as 'awe-inspiring'; a real scenic stop. Against: one source, no location or access given anywhere (not on Wikivoyage, DOC or Wikipedia, and OSM lookups were rate-limited), so it cannot be pinned. Stays review pending coordinates.

name: Glory Cottage
objection: Changed to reject: one source (tourism board); a restored 1860s cottage on Pitt Island with no stated public access, part of the Pitt Island visit; Glory Bay already rejected as the same stop.

name: Fossil Rocks
objection: Changed to reject: Wikivoyage only mentions fossicking for 40-million-year-old shark teeth on beaches generally; no defined stop or access, so not a distinct place.
